text: 🎬 The Dave Bautista horror movie Netflix can't stop watching M. Night Shyamalan's Knock at the Cabin is dominating Netflix charts three years after its release. A family on vacation, four armed strangers, one apocalyptic ultimatum. Shyamalan keeps it lean and suffocating for all 100 minutes. Bautista plays Leonard, the soft-spoken ringleader. It's the best dramatic performance of his career, full stop. He makes you feel sorry for the man holding a weapon to your head. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🎬 Dark Matter season 2 finds the book's darkest beat, and plays it smarter Episode 5 is where the show earns its second season. Rather than a straight lift of what Blake Crouch wrote, the adaptation re-contextualizes the source novel's most gut-punch moment for a story that has evolved well beyond its starting point. That's the move good showrunners make. Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly get material that honors the emotional weight of the book without turning it into a museum piece. Subtle is harder than faithful, and here it actually lands. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🎬 Tom Cruise's big swing with Inarritu could land with a thud Digger is eyeing a $20-29M domestic opening against a $130M budget. For a Cruise vehicle directed by Alejandro G. Inarritu, that's not just underwhelming. It's ugly. The combo looked bold on paper: Inarritu doing comedy, Cruise playing a grotesque oil billionaire. But mixed reviews landed early and audiences seem genuinely unmoved. Star power can't paper over that. ✈️ Add to watchlist
